description: This file contains unit tests for the NetlinkRequest class, which constructs netlink messages for network configuration. It includes tests for request data validation, header correctness, and various nested list structures used in netlink communication.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Dumps a hex buffer to the test log with a title, formatting the output in lines of 16 bytes.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two memory buffers byte-by-byte, logs the first difference, and dumps both buffers if a mismatch is found.
